Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Content Designer (Conversational AI) position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I have developed a strong foundation in crafting user-centered content that improves discoverability and engagement. My experience includes writing keyword-targeted blog content, designing website structures, and implementing structured data to enhance AI search visibility.

While my current role focuses on SEO and web content, I am eager to apply my skills to conversational design. I have a keen interest in how users interact with AI-powered services and have been actively learning about conversation design principles. My technical background in web development and my attention to detail make me well-suited to create natural, helpful dialogue flows.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am comfortable working hybrid or remote. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and improving. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your team and help shape exceptional conversational experiences.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your projects.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Content Designer (Conversational AI) role. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), I have developed a deep understanding of how users interact with digital content—both on traditional websites and through AI-powered search engines. This role presents a perfect opportunity to channel my skills into designing intuitive, user-centric conversational experiences.

In my current position at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that drives organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring seamless user experiences. My work on mirook.com, a personal project, has involved implementing structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and llms.txt to improve visibility across AI search engines—experience that directly translates to understanding how AI systems interpret and respond to content.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines my passion for clear, helpful writing with my interest in AI technology. I have been actively learning about conversation design and user-centered content creation, and I am eager to apply these principles to design natural, engaging dialogue flows. My ability to analyze user feedback and data, honed through tracking performance with tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush, will help me continuously improve content effectiveness.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am comfortable with hybrid or remote work. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and improving. I am confident that my blend of technical, analytical, and creative skills makes me a strong fit for this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
